title: Among customers who made a purchase of product ID 5 at a unit price (Price
question: Among customers who made a purchase of product ID 5 at a unit price (Price / Amount) greater than 28.50, identify those who belong to the SME segment and pay in Czech koruna (CZK). For these customers, compute how many had total gas consumption below 27,500 during 2013.

prediction.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.XCL_001 FROM customers AS c WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'SME' AND c.XCL_003 = 'CZK' AND c.XCL_001 IN (SELECT t.XCL_013 FROM transactions_1k AS t WHERE t.XCL_016 = 5 AND CAST(t.XCL_018 AS REAL) / t.XCL_017 > 28.50) AND c.XCL_001 IN (SELECT y.XCL_019 FROM yearmonth AS y WHERE SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013' GROUP BY y.XCL_019 HAVING SUM(y.XCL_021) < 27500)) AS eligible_customers

measures.eligibility_application: count only customers passing all eligibility predicates
measures.multiplicity_argument: inner subquery returns one row per eligible customer because it selects customers.XCL_001 from customers with semijoin/IN conditions, so COUNT(*) counts customers, not transaction or month rows

measures.eligibility_application: used only to select customers whose 2013 total gas consumption is below 27500
measures.multiplicity_argument: grouped by yearmonth.XCL_019 before HAVING, so monthly rows are aggregated to customer grain before eligibility is applied

unresolved_choices.reason: No separate price column exists in transactions_1k; historical aliases identify XCL_018 as total amount and XCL_017 as quantity.

arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT c.XCL_001
  FROM customers AS c
  WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'SME'
    AND c.XCL_003 = 'CZK'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM transactions_1k AS t
      WHERE t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
        AND t.XCL_016 = 5
        AND CAST(t.XCL_018 AS REAL) / t.XCL_017 > 28.50
    )
    AND c.XCL_001 IN (
      SELECT y.XCL_019
      FROM yearmonth AS y
      WHERE SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013'
      GROUP BY y.XCL_019
      HAVING SUM(y.XCL_021) < 27500
    )
) AS eligible_customers

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT c.XCL_001
  FROM customers AS c
  WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'SME'
    AND c.XCL_003 = 'CZK'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM transactions_1k AS t
      WHERE t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
        AND t.XCL_016 = 5
        AND CAST(t.XCL_018 AS REAL) / t.XCL_017 > 28.50
    )
    AND c.XCL_001 IN (
      SELECT y.XCL_019
      FROM yearmonth AS y
      WHERE SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013'
      GROUP BY y.XCL_019
      HAVING SUM(y.XCL_021) < 27500
    )
) AS eligible_customers

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT c.XCL_001
  FROM customers c
  JOIN transactions_1k t ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
  WHERE t.XCL_016 = 5
    AND CAST(t.XCL_014 AS REAL) / t.XCL_017 > 28.50
    AND c.XCL_002 = 'SME'
    AND c.XCL_003 = 'CZK'
  GROUP BY c.XCL_001
  HAVING c.XCL_001 IN (
    SELECT y.XCL_019
    FROM yearmonth y
    WHERE SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY y.XCL_019
    HAVING SUM(y.XCL_021) < 27500
  )
) AS t
